continuation: Held full-replay boundary through existing notifier, then measured C06 or useful registered extensions. Fixed freeze, confirmation and Friday clocks unchanged.
controls: Known mechanism match beats wrong mechanism with a supplied parser.
Same style alone fails when the mechanism differs.
Two physical inversions can cancel for the raw surface reader.
Independent scalar count fit and every finite selector match.
criteria: Descriptive uncapped log loss, full multiclass Brier and modal accuracy for every locality and decoder. Report native-to-independent and native-to-reversed changes. Stop interpreting style match alone as mechanism compatibility; retain accidental double-inversion surface success. No B/C superiority or confirmation admission.
evidence: Rendered token, declared rendering code and arbitrary labels identifying available local archives. Correct mechanism archive identity is supplied as a diagnostic privilege, not learned family recognition. Decoder uses only its selected fitted table.
generator: Target and mechanism are independent balanced bits. Mechanism flips target before shared binary noise with world-specific reliability Uniform(.7,.95). Independently assigned rendering style flips the resulting token. Test style agrees with mechanism at .9 natively, .5 independently and .1 after reversal. Shared target, mechanism, noise and style draws pair all regimes.
limitations: Purpose-built miniature — architecture untested; no actual LLM or human family behavior.
Binary flips are stipulated mechanisms and can cancel; unknown renderers and learned family selection remain untested.
Noise laws are separately drawn but reused development identities do not become confirmation.
No product-of-factors reader; duplicate-removal contrast unavailable.
Proper binary scores occupy two states in the common 128-state scorer; extra zero states add no evidence.
pairing: Two fit seeds nested in each of eight worlds; 4096 paired whole-world bootstrap draws after averaging fits. Cases, locality cells and regimes are not independent worlds.
population: Finite binary mechanism/rendering ruler with eight independently drawn noise-reliability worlds; reused V21 development identities.
privileges: All four local training archives available identically; no optimizer or hidden capacity difference.
question: Does compatibility track producer mechanism or surface rendering under equal local training volume and reversed style correlations?
random_labels: Independent random permutations of mechanism and style archive names; selecting by renamed equality and applying the declared parser must preserve all forecasts. This renames archive identities, not training targets.
training: Every reader fits all four mechanism/style archives with 512 labels each, selecting one archive per query. Archives share target/noise draws within each fit and world; exact half-count-smoothed binary tables have equal capacity. Archive selection by physical mechanism and rendering identity is supplied. No reader receives the generating reliability; no true target enters selection.
validation: Two focused controls, two complete 64-file engineering consumers, independent scalar fitter/selector, full-size one-world two-fit pilot, every scientific score and full frozen-source replay before acceptance.
